personality_one_liner: A cinematic, obsidian-glass Telegram Mini App marketplace delivering high-performance digital goods with tactile LED lighting and precision dark aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Generous obsidian padding and touch-first vertical rhythms tailored for Telegram WebView.

do's: Use backdrop blur on sticky navigation and product hero cards
Layer frosted glass with 80%+ obsidian tint for pristine text contrast
Incorporate tactile LED edge highlights for active marketplace cards
dont's: Never blur body text or form inputs
Never stack more than two glass layers simultaneously
Avoid unreadable transparency over dense product grids

screens.name: Intro
screens.purpose: 3-4 second cinematic obsidian intro sequence featuring VTH Network branding and Telegram WebApp status check.

states.loading: Animating neon obsidian logo pulse and loading session...
states.error: Failed to initialize Telegram WebApp context. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Centered logo with animated particle ring, fade-in typography, automatic transition to Home.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary digital marketplace hub featuring wallet balance card and four category cards (TG-Lion, LZT Market, TemporaSMS, Verified VTH).

states.loading: Skeleton grid with shimmering glass card placeholders.
states.empty: No active marketplace products found. Check back soon.
states.error: Failed to fetch live inventory. Retry connection.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with top sticky obsidian header, wallet balance card, category pill filter, and 2-column product grid.

screens.name: MarketplaceListing
screens.purpose: Detailed product and country catalog with instant search, sorting, stock states, and filtering.

states.empty: No items match your search criteria. Try a different filter.
states.error: Catalog service unreachable. Tap to reconnect.

screens.layout: Top sticky search bar, horizontal sort chips, and vertical scrollable product item rows with stock badges and instant action buttons.

screens.name: ProductDetail
screens.purpose: Comprehensive inspection of selected digital good with specs, pricing tiers, purchase policy modal, and checkout trigger.

states.loading: Hero image shimmer and detail skeleton.
states.error: Failed to load product spec. Retry.

screens.layout: Hero banner with gradient scrim, specification pills, purchase policy terms accordion, and sticky bottom purchase CTA bar.

screens.name: Orders
screens.purpose: Track active and historical digital goods purchases, credentials delivery, and TemporaSMS waiting state.

states.empty: No orders placed yet. Explore the marketplace to make your first purchase.

screens.layout: Segmented control (All / Active / Completed), vertical order list cards with status pills and copy credentials action.

screens.name: Wallet
screens.purpose: Manage balance and execute secure recharges across Auto UPI, Auto Crypto, Manual UPI, and Manual Crypto methods.

states.loading: Wallet balance skeleton and transaction loader.

screens.layout: Top balance summary card, 4 recharge method action buttons, active verification-pending state tracker, and transaction history feed.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Telegram user session details, VIP tier status, security settings, support, and admin portal gateway.
screens.layout: Avatar header with Telegram user ID badge, VIP loyalty card, settings list rows, and protected admin portal gateway.

screens.name: AdminPortal
screens.purpose: Restricted administrative command center for inventory management, provider sync, and transaction audits.
screens.layout: Restricted access check banner, key metrics summary cards, provider health status toggles, and recent security logs list.

intro_logo.alt: VTH Network obsidian cyber logo backdrop

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete VTH Network / VTH Store Telegram Mini App marketplace with all 8 screens and flows.
Enforce Glass / Luxe DARK personality with deep obsidian surfaces, frosted glass cards, and crisp crimson/ruby accents.
Implement the 3-4s introductory cinematic sequence before entering the marketplace home screen.
Build robust state management for wallet recharges (Auto/Manual UPI & Crypto) with verification pending states.
Implement TemporaSMS waiting-for-OTP/cancellation architecture and secure credential copy actions.
Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt and safe area insets are respected across Telegram WebView surfaces.
Verify WCAG AA contrast on all glass cards with multi-stop gradient scrims and high-contrast typography.
